assessment: Lower specified gate leakage than DMN52D0U, but conditions differ; not a measured operating-point comparison.
Large typical input/output capacitance makes this a poor default for the high-impedance signal and SETI branches. Do not adopt based only on low on-resistance.
Q5 output capacitance is behind R45; 195 pF is not directly the capacitance at SETI. A network transient assessment is still required.
Temperature-range limits, exact ordering code and current stock remain unresolved. No PCB or BOM change.
